origin.basis: Vredestein was founded in 1908 in the Netherlands and has been owned by Apollo Tyres Ltd since 2009 (heritage page).

manufacturing.basis: The product page does not state where the tire is made.

weight_basis: Vredestein size-table weights (black sidewall unless noted).

availability.note: Vredestein's Dutch site lists the tire with a dealer finder and no price; other regions not verified.

name: Superpasso Pro (tube type)
positioning: Tube-type version of the 120 TPI Superpasso Pro race tire.
caveats: Needs an inner tube; the Superpasso Pro TLR is listed separately.
No independent lab test of this model found.

image.shown: Black Superpasso Pro as pictured on Vredestein's product page; Vredestein shows this photo for the tube-type and TLR versions, and the construction is not visible.
image.alt: Vredestein Superpasso Pro road tire with black sidewalls, angled view

rights.usage_note: The maker's own product photo, shown from the maker's website; no copy is stored or redistributed by this project, and no license is asserted.

owner_evidence.screening_note: Coded on 2026-11-04 from a fixed source set: the written reviews on the Sigma Sports and bike-components product pages, read in full through each page's own review list (the newest 15 per page when more exist), every reader comment on Bicycle Rolling Resistance's test pages for this tire, and owner comments in coded Xiaohongshu threads. Counted only owners who describe their own riding; star-only ratings, reviews without riding detail, mounting-only impressions and repeats were left out. Comments on one construction's test page count for that construction unless the owner names the other.
